word.description: The word `status` and `runs` print for the run.

liveness.description: How the run is being driven: the driver-liveness word.

driven.description: Whether anything is driving the run.

ending.description: How the run ended, or `null` for a run that has not.

paused.description: The decision the run is paused on, or `null` for a run that is not.

title: RunReading
description:
Whether a run is driven or ended, as one document a script reads:
`onepipeline status <RUN> --json`.

`ending` and `paused` are never both set, and both are `null` while the run is
driven. `schemas/run-reading.schema.json` states the document.

kind.description: Which ending: the run-end hook judge's verdict.

nodes.description:
Every node not `done`, in plan order — the list a failure hook is handed,
and empty for `complete`.

Ending.description: How a run ended, and every node not `done` when it did.

oneOf.description: Every node is `done`: the success hook's ending.
A node is `failed` or `skipped`: the failure hook's `nodes` reason.

A node is not `done`, none failed or skipped, and nothing is left to
decide: the failure hook's `unfinished` reason.

A `stop` was recorded and no driver has adopted the run since: the
failure hook's `stopped` reason.

EndingKind.description: How a run ended: the run-end hook judge's own verdict, read back.

outcome.description: The outcome its settlement recorded, or `null` for a node that recorded none.

EndedNode.description: One node that was not `done` when a run ended — as a failure hook is handed it.

human_actions.description:
Each waiting human action, by node id: completed with `attest`, or
retired with a `drop`.

blocking_surface.description: Whether a blocking planner question is outstanding, answered with `reply`.

Paused.description: The decision a run nothing is driving is paused on.
